Strategy: Take the typical bin. Prefer the bin whose residual is closest to the geometric mean of all residuals, below the mean when a few bins are loose. This skips the tightest bin, kept for exact fits, and the loosest bins, kept for big items, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the typical bin is not the tightest. It may help by filling typical bins first, but may fail by stranding tight bins if later items run large.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    g = exp(sum([log(r) for r in bins]) / len(bins))
    return [-abs(r - g) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Geometric-mean targeting: prefer bin whose residual is closest to geometric mean of residuals.
